tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, inputs and dialogs; sits on ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, code blocks, the track of a switch or tab bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders (3:1 on ground and surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-sunken, yapi-soft and saffron.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on ground, surface or surface-sunken.

tokens.name: yapi
tokens.usage: Brand green: primary buttons, links, active and selected state, success. As text, on ground or surface.

tokens.name: yapi-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a yapi fill.

tokens.name: on-yapi
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a yapi or yapi-strong fill.

tokens.name: yapi-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows, info and success notes; text on it is ink or yapi.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Accent fill for highlights, warnings and new badges. Never text; text on it is ink in light, ground in dark.

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a saffron fill.

tokens.name: saffron-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for warning notes; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; as text on ground, surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for error notes; text on it is ink or danger.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and empty-state headlines only.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree (Google Fonts) for everything people read and operate.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Changes are saved as you type.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding on desktop.

radius.note: Squared-off, like building blocks; only pills are round.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and avatars.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the work; shadows only for things that float. Darker and tighter in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards that sit above a busy ground.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the ground color, then a 2px yapi ring.

size.note: Control heights. Everything a finger taps is at least 36px.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense tables and toolbars (desktop only).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call to action on marketing and onboarding screens.

duration.note: Motion is short and functional; honour prefers-reduced-motion by dropping to 0ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switch thumb, tab indicator, dialog fade.
